🏆 **NEXUSX DAILY PRACTICE SERIES**
**Season 1 – The Beginning**
Organizer: NexusX Esports India
Tagline: Solo Skill. Ultimate Victory.

🔥 Welcome to NexusX BGMI Solo Practice Series! Compete in daily custom room matches, improve your survival skills, earn daily cash prizes, and fight for the Weekly Champion title.

🎮 **TOURNAMENT DETAILS**
• Game: BGMI
• Mode: Solo TPP
• Platform: Mobile Phone Only
• Entry Fee: 100% FREE
• Match Start: 8:00 PM IST
• Room Details: 7:45 PM IST (Verified Players Only)

🗓️ **MATCH SCHEDULE**
• 17 Nov – Erangel
• 18 Nov – Miramar
• 19 Nov – Rondo
• 20 Nov – Sanhok
• 21 Nov – Vikendi

💰 **PRIZE POOL**
🥇 Daily Winner (1st Place): ₹50 via UPI
🏆 Weekly Champion: ₹100 Extra via UPI

Maximum planned prize budget: ₹350.

📊 **POINTS SYSTEM (No Kill Points)**
1st: 15 | 2nd: 12 | 3rd: 10 | 4th: 8 | 5th: 6 | 6th: 5 | 7th: 4 | 8th: 3 | 9th: 2 | 10th: 1 | 11th onwards: 0.

Tie-breakers: Highest total points > Most 1st places > Most 2nd places > Most 3rd places > Admin review.

🏆 **WEEKLY CHAMPION RULE**
Players must register for and attend all five matches. If the highest overall points scorer misses even one match, the ₹100 weekly prize will be forfeited and will NOT pass to the next player. Daily prizes remain independent.

📸 **RESULTS & PAYMENTS**
Results are subject to admin verification. Players may submit screenshots or recordings as supporting evidence. UPI prizes are targeted for processing after 9:00 PM IST, subject to verification and organizer confirmation.

⚠️ **DISCLAIMER**
NexusX Esports India is an independent community organizer and is not officially affiliated with or sponsored by KRAFTON/BGMI. Schedules, room availability, slots and prizes are subject to organizer confirmation.

🔥 **REGISTER FREE. ENTER THE BATTLE. PROVE YOUR SKILLS.**
